insight.headline: Order Tax Recalculation
insight.what_changed: The orderUpdate GraphQL mutation now recalculates taxes when the shipping address is updated for an unfulfilled order. This change affects the GraphQL Admin API and is available as of September 9, 2026. The recalculation is done against the new destination.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should be aware of this change when updating orders through the GraphQL Admin API. They should test their apps to ensure they handle the tax recalculation correctly. The orderUpdate mutation now returns the updated taxes, so developers should update their code to handle this new response. Additionally, developers should review their tax calculation logic to ensure it aligns with this new behavior.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will see more accurate tax calculations when the shipping address is updated for an unfulfilled order. This change will help merchants comply with tax regulations and avoid potential tax liabilities.
insight.why_it_matters: This change improves the accuracy of tax calculations and helps merchants comply with tax regulations. It also ensures that developers' apps handle tax calculations correctly, which is essential for a seamless customer experience.

also_worth_knowing.text: Shop Campaigns performance data now available via ShopifyQL
Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes

updates.title: Shop Campaigns performance data now available via ShopifyQL
updates.summary: Shop Campaigns performance data is now available via ShopifyQL, allowing analytics and reporting apps to query performance data on behalf of authorized merchants.
CLI version 4.6.1 now serves UI extension source maps during app development, improving the development experience.

updates.title: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes
updates.summary: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, allowing for more flexible and dynamic cart management.

updates.title: Draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is moving from reserved to committed
updates.summary: Draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is being moved from reserved to committed, changing how in-progress inventory holds are represented.

updates.title: WebMCP support for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts
updates.summary: WebMCP support is now available for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts, allowing AI agents to interact with online stores.

updates.title: Oxygen is now available on development stores
updates.summary: Oxygen is now available on development stores, allowing developers to deploy Hydrogen storefronts to Oxygen from dev stores.

updates.title: The `orderCreate` mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment
updates.summary: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, improving order management capabilities.

updates.title: Updated Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps
updates.summary: Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps have been updated, making it easier for apps to achieve Built for Shopify status.

updates.title: Hydrogen developer preview update: July 30, 2026
updates.summary: The Hydrogen developer preview has been updated, adding new capabilities to the toolkit and extending the ways developers can build Shopify storefronts.

updates.title: New fields for cash management activities and drawers in POS
updates.summary: New fields are now available on cash management resources in the GraphQL Admin API, providing more detail about cash drawer balances and cash count activities.
CLI version 4.6.0 has been released, removing deprecated draftable extension process and dev session support branching, and adding flags to avoid prompts in app config link.

recap.headline: ShopifyQL and CLI updates enhance developer experience

themes.title: ShopifyQL Enhancements
themes.detail: Shop Campaigns performance data is now available via ShopifyQL, allowing analytics and reporting apps to query data on behalf of authorized merchants. This update expands the capabilities of the GraphQL Admin API. Developers can leverage the shop_campaign_insights schema to build more informed apps.

themes.title: CLI Updates
themes.detail: The Shopify CLI has been updated to version 4.6.1, which includes serving UI extension source maps during app development. This change improves the development experience for building Checkout UI extensions and other apps using the CLI.
